item.title: For some patients, psychedelic treatment brings new troubles in its aftermath
item.description: Psychedelics could transform mental health care, but some advocates and researchers say there needs to be more focus on the minority of people with persistent troubles after using these drugs.

item.title: Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority, court rules
item.description: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority — a landmark judgment that marks a turning point in international justice.
item.content:encoded: The International Court of Justice has ruled that Myanmar committed genocide against its Rohingya Muslim minority — a landmark judgment that marks a turning point in international justice.

item.title: A new concerto highlights an instrument usually in the background: the timpani
item.description: The Seattle Symphony is premiering a new concerto that spotlights a solo performance of an instrument pretty rarely featured in such solos: the timpani.
item.content:encoded: The Seattle Symphony is premiering a new concerto that spotlights a solo performance of an instrument pretty rarely featured in such solos: the timpani.

item.title: The AI boom is the biggest gold rush San Francisco's seen yet
item.description: NPR's Sacha Pfeiffer talks with Ben Steverman of Bloomberg about how the incredible amount of wealth generated by AI startups is transforming the San Francisco Bay Area.

item.title: How non-player characters in 'Grand Theft Auto VI' help create its big world
item.description: In video games, "barks" are short lines of dialogue given to various characters in the world. Grand Theft Auto VI proves how this kind of dialogue contributes to an immersive world.

item.title: Why the U.S. air traffic control system still relies on an 'antique' network
item.description: Friday's nationwide ground stop was a stark reminder that the U.S.'s air traffic control systems are old and fragile. How did things get so bad, and why is it so hard to replace outdated equipment?

item.title: For new members of Congress, getting a prime office is a game of chance
item.description: Orientation for incoming House members is coming to a close. After two weeks of training, leadership elections and happy hours, one of the last rites of passage is the office lottery.
